pages.text: Every weapon type has its own reach and area of effect, in three broad shapes:$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Balanced$(): a medium arc in front of you. Shortswords, axes, blunt weapons.$(li)$(bold)Wide$(): a broad arc. Greatswords, scythes.$(li)$(bold)Forward$(): long and narrow. Spears, rapiers, lances.
The enemy you aim at takes the full blow a moment into the swing, not on the click; slower weapons land later. Most weapons also catch other enemies inside their reach shape for part of the damage.
